issues.question: Is petitioner entitled to a 2020 gambling loss deduction beyond the amount respondent allowed?
issues.holding: Yes: court estimated losses at least equal to winnings; deduction of $61,929 allowed (capped at gambling gains)
issues.computable_reason: Given the finding that losses >= winnings, §165(d) caps the deduction at winnings ($61,929); the loss finding itself is a Cohan estimate.

issues.question: Is petitioner liable for the section 6662(a) accuracy-related penalty for 2020?
issues.holding: Liable: supervisory approval timely obtained; petitioner failed to show reasonable cause and good faith
issues.computable_reason: Decided on 6751(b) compliance and reasonable cause; the amount of the remaining underpayment is left to Rule 155.

decision.text: Decision will be entered under Rule 155.
decision.summary: 2020 gambling losses allowed in full ($61,929); 6662(a) penalty sustained for 2020; other 2020/2021 issues settled.

notes: Opinion does not say whether the penalty rests on substantial understatement or negligence. 2021 issues resolved by stipulation; not decided in the opinion. Petitioner bore burden; 7491(a) not raised.
